name: m4-simple-loading-opengl-vs-metal
threshold_rationale: The Simple draw is an opaque quad over a cleared BGRA8 target, sampled with the same linear filter on both backends. No anti-aliasing, dithering or alpha blending is required for this draw (the quad covers the viewport and alpha is 1). Exact integer equality is therefore the initial policy; a tolerance may only be adopted with an independently measured control and a recorded rationale before candidate qualification.
vertex_inputs_rationale: The engine builds the loading quad from the texture description; different POW2/caps state changes the live V range (0..1 vs 0..0.75). The comparator therefore requires the same live slot-0 vertex payload on both sides, not merely the same caller.

measured_basis.note: Exact equality observed on 1,930,176 pixels across independent launches with identical live vertex inputs; a non-zero tolerance is not justified.
